schema.name: Smile Makeover with crowns, bridges and veneers

hero.definition: Smile Makeover with crowns, bridges and veneers replaces or rebuilds up to 20 teeth with porcelain crowns, bridges or veneers, planned together so color, shape and bite match. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami the package costs $6,999, includes a professional cleaning and X-rays, is delivered in 5 business days and carries a 5-year written warranty.
hero.lead: Up to 20 crowns, bridges or veneers from one plan and one in-house lab. Delivered in 5 business days in Miami, or 3 with rush delivery, with a 5-year warranty in writing.

price.title: One price for 20 restorations, in writing
price.body: Send photos and a doctor replies with your treatment plan within 6 hours. Individual crowns and bridges are $500 each when done with your smile design, veneers $1,000; the $6,999 package covers a full set of 20. Deep cleaning and other procedures are quoted separately, in writing, before anything starts.
price.footnote: Prices shown are minimum fees. Your final fee is confirmed in writing after a doctor's evaluation.

faq.title: Restoration questions, answered by the doctors

items.q: Crown, bridge or veneer: who decides?
items.a: Your doctor, tooth by tooth, at Visit 1. A veneer covers the front of a healthy tooth; a crown rebuilds a broken or heavily filled one; a bridge replaces a missing tooth using the neighbors. You confirm the plan before any preparation.
Preparation is done under local anesthesia. Expect soreness for a few days, managed with over-the-counter pain relief.
Crowns and bridges are often classed as major restorative work and may be covered 50 to 80 percent depending on your plan. We give you the codes for your claim.
Porcelain and zirconia restorations typically last 10 to 30 years with good care. Ours carry a 5-year written warranty.

items.q: Can it be done in 3 days?
items.a: Yes. Rush delivery in 3 business days is $10,000 instead of $6,999, because the lab works on your case exclusively. Most patients choose the standard 5-day schedule.
